mission.title: The Lighter Side of Slaughter
mission.description: Strike a Zion insecticide lab and a Machine storehouse.

phase.briefing:
Those miserable Zion operatives and Machine-following fools have tested the Merovingian's patience -- and mine, for far too long. We must hit them where it counts: assault their insecticide lab and flit gun storehouse.
The first part of your assignment is to strike a Zion insecticide lab. While you're there, say "hi" to the technician for me.

enter.say: This looks like a quick in-and-out job. Only two signals pop up on the scanner, but there could be more. You know the drill.

objective.text: Kill all of the Zion operatives in the lab

near.say: {player}, I think Flood wants the lab worker dead too. If I'm wrong, well... it's good to be on the safe side.

phase.briefing:
Things are proceeding as planned. This is well and good, but I've decided to call upon a few friends... to aid you in the slaughter.
Pick them up and lead them to the Machine storehouse. Trust me. You could use the help.

enter.say: Ugh! Flood is probably making you babysit the new recruits. What a surprise.

talk.say: We must move quickly, {player}. My whole body aches for the chance to drain the blood of the tainted.
Okay, this is a surprise! I was expecting something less...capable. Nevertheless, this is your strike team. Let's get a move on.

Howl do you do?
Humph. Just my little joke. That's all.
If you took a single minute longer, I would've bit my own arm off.

objective.text: Lead the strike team out of the area

phase.briefing:
Your objectives are quite simple. It's carrying them out that's the hard part. Go to the Machine storehouse and kill the small army you find there.
Oh, and one more thing: do not leave without details on our enemies' next plan of action. We cannot allow Zion or the Machines to stay one step ahead of us, now, can we?

enter.say: That's strange... My readings look like you just stepped into a ghost town. I'm only seeing two signals. I thought there was supposed to be a "small army" here.
There's a desk inside the next room... My money is on the off chance that it holds the information Flood seeks.

done.say: That was a freakin' massacre! Look at the bodies! Corpses everywhere! That was... insane!

objective.text: Find the details on the enemies' next plan

done.say: You're kidding me! It actually says "Secret Plans" right on the folder! Why didn't they just put a giant green arrow on the desk, while they're at it!
Sweet! Get those secret plans to a hardline and I'll pass 'em off to good ol' Floody.

objective.text: Upload the secret plans at a hardline

done.say: The docs are secure. Nice work, {player}.

near.say: I'm seeing at least three new signals descending on your position!
Your own mother won't recognize you after I'm through with you.

mission.finish:
Don't you ever get a bit jealous? I sit back and drink port while you carry out my -- I mean -- the Merovingian's bidding. Then again, you're the one who is quite good at that sort of thing -- killing, that is.
I'm sending the Merovingian the details of your assignment. I'm sure he'll squeal like a giggling school girl as always... Eh.
